n: ASU Robotic Rhythms with Edison robots
t: A fifth grade music lesson where students build rhythm sequences with Edison robots.
steps: Find the Robotic Rhythms lesson on the ASU STEM Teachers site.
Open the slides if the page loads.
Prepare computers or tablets with the EdBlocks editor.
Check whether the lesson uses EdBlocks or EdScratch.
Test the robot's sound and percussion features.
Plan about 60 minutes for the lesson.
